title: Zindagi
desc: Zindagi

title: Dhanya Rahim
desc: Javed Akhtar explains the expression of emotions in a wide range. He says people who do not overtly express their emotions, leave room for more interpretation, empathy and genuine compassion.

title: Rahiman Nijman
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nijman" where he says, self-pity & soliciting for sympathy doesn?t get us anywhere. It is always wise to keep our troubles with ourself to not get ridiculed.

title: Rahiman Teen
desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which arose the essence of life.

title: Kahi Rahim
desc: Javed Akhtar, takes us through various shayaaris where Sharaab is used as a symbol to explain a concept that talks about various examples of life.

title: Rahiman Priti
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the word 'Awaaz' and its various forms, the one that we use to talk to others, the one that we raise as an opinion & the one that is within us.

title: Rahiman Dhaga Prem
desc: Rahiman Dhaga Prem

title: Kufr
desc: Javed Akhtar says we humans are so caught up in our personal lives that we don't realise the entire world is flooded with many problems. We talk about them for some time & then go back to our normal lives.

title: Guncha
desc: Javed Akhtar says our lives are moving so quickly that the destinations are being left far behind. In this fast-paced life we need to take breaks more often to enjoy the small moments of lives.

title: Raat
desc: Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which arose the essence of life.

title: Tere Baghair
desc: Javed Akhtar tells how the path of life can lead you to various destinations & explains minute details about human relations & human interactions. He says that the journey of life is different for all.

title: Rail
desc: Javed Akhtar explains how water can be associated with various aspects of life. It is sometimes used to explain depth, power & at times happiness as well.

title: Sawal Jawab
desc: Javed Akhtar says trees have been an integral part of mankind & suggests the use of tree to depict various aspects of life - exploitation, hibernation, bearing fruits of success, hope & companionship.

title: Sharaab
desc: Javed Akhtar says ustaad shayars usually despised prejudice, strong held traditions, superstitions in their couplets & wrote more about humanity, companionship, friendship & love in one's life.

title: Awaaz
desc: Javed Aktar compares life to a budding flower, he further says there are many elements that are waiting to prevent it from blossoming. We therefore must focus on how to protect it & help it grow beautifully.

title: Rahiman Dekhi
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Dekhi" where he says, do not forget the small things in life after seeing big ones, as everything whether big or small is useful in some or the other way.
